title: Factor Analysis
summary: Exploratory factor analysis; principal component method; unique variance; key features and assumptions.
objectives: Define factor analysis and exploratory factor analysis.
Interpret factor loadings, eigenvalues and unique variance.
revision: Factor analysis finds latent factors from observed variables. PCM extracts max variance. Factor loading = correlation; eigenvalue = variance explained.
traps: Eigenvalue > 1 = Kaiser criterion for retaining factors.

notes.t: A statistical method for identifying underlying dimensions (factors) that explain patterns of correlations among a set of observed variables.
Used when the researcher does not have a pre-specified factor structure and wants to discover the underlying factors.

i: Extracts components that account for maximum variance.
Each component is a linear combination of observed variables.
Unique variance = variance not shared with other variables.

r: Amount of variance explained by a factor

notes.t: Factor analysis reduces many variables to fewer factors. PCM extracts maximum-variance components. Eigenvalue > 1 is a common retention rule (Kaiser criterion).

mnemonics.title: FLE
mnemonics.text: F — Factor (underlying dimension), L — Loading (variable–factor correlation), E — Eigenvalue (variance explained).

flashcards.a: Correlation between a variable and a factor.
Amount of variance explained by a factor.
